weekLabel.zh: 本周更新 · 8 月 31 日 – 9 月 6 日

title.zh: 《An Extended Look》4 天狂揽 3110 万次观看，登顶 Netflix 全球榜
title.en: Extended Look hits 31.1M views in 4 days, tops Netflix worldwide

summary.zh: Netflix 官方周榜：GTA6 实机演示断层式登顶，几乎在所有上榜国家排名第一，YouTube 播放量另计——史上最强游戏营销事件再添佐证。
summary.en: Netflix's official weekly chart has the GTA 6 showcase as the runaway #1 globally, with YouTube views on top.

title.zh: 25 年惯例终结：GTA6 奔跑键改为按下左摇杆
title.en: After 25 years, the sprint button finally changes

summary.zh: 实机演示确认 GTA6 取消连打 X 键加速奔跑，改为 L3 一键全速——伴随罪犯档案、六星通缉等系统革新的又一处细节。
summary.en: GTA 6 ditches the 25-year-old tap-to-sprint for a single L3 press, per the Extended Look.

title.zh: Rockstar 官宣 GTA Online 官方 RP 服务器，NoPixel 5 封测下周开启
title.en: Rockstar unveils its official GTA Online RP server with NoPixel 5

summary.zh: Rockstar 首次官方下场 RP 服务器运营，观战模式封测下周上线；距 GTA6 发售不足三个月，多人模式动向值得关注。
summary.en: Rockstar's first official RP server arrives with a watch-only closed beta next week — an interesting signal ahead of GTA 6.

title.zh: 四大 P0 关键词页上线：终极汇总 / 预购指南 / PC 澄清 / Trailer 3 追踪
title.en: Four P0 keyword pages live: ultimate guide, pre-order, PC, Trailer 3

summary.zh: 「Everything We Know」终极汇总页成为全站内链枢纽；预购指南附 FAQ 结构化数据与官方购买渠道直链，冲刺 9 月底 SEO 收录目标。
summary.en: The Everything We Know hub anchors the site's internal linking, with the pre-order guide carrying FAQ schema and official store links.

title.zh: 站点升级：FAQ 富结果、预购渠道直链与全新霓虹 OG 分享图
title.en: Site upgrade: FAQ rich results, store links, and a new neon OG card

summary.zh: 新闻管线恢复每日编辑发布；Everything We Know 与预购页接入 FAQPage 结构化数据，OG 分享卡重制为 Vice City 霓虹风。
summary.en: Daily editorial pipeline restored; FAQPage schema on key pages and a redesigned Vice City neon share card.
